# IT Escalation and Post-Mortem Report: Payroll Batch Failure
Escalation ID: ESC-2026-8814

## Incident Summary
On 03/12/2026 at 09:15 AM, Tier 1 received six high-priority tickets from the Finance Department. Users reported that the local client for ApexPay 2026 froze during biweekly direct-deposit generation. The issue was escalated to Systems Engineering at 09:42 AM after initial workstation-level troubleshooting failed.

## Environment Diagnostics
| Metric / Resource | Normal Baseline | Incident Reading (09:30 AM) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| App Host CPU (SRV-PAY-01) | 18% - 35% | 22% |
| Host RAM Utilization | 40% - 60% | 51% |
| SQL Transaction Log Disk (L:) | 250 GB Free | 0 MB Free (Volume Exhausted) |
| Database Service Status | Running | Paused (Error 9002) |

## Root Cause Analysis
The ApexPay database service entered an automated recovery pause. Because host CPU utilization reached critical threshold capacity, the database engine halted all write transactions to protect file headers.

## Mitigation Actions
- Tier 3 purged uncommitted staging tables and expanded drive L: by 150 GB.
- Database service was resumed at 10:18 AM, and Finance completed the batch without payroll disbursement delay.
- Applied routine security patches.

## Preventative Changes
- Configure automated disk growth alerts on drive L: at 15% remaining capacity.
- Schedule daily transaction log truncations with standard hourly backups.
